name: Mesh grid
summary: A 3D wireframe of the spectrum's history: each row the spectrum of a moment, rolling away as a terrain of peaks and valleys, flat, round or in a spiral; beats send ripples through it.
credit: After vizz.fm's Mesh Grid (https://vizz.fm). No code used; written new with Claude Code.
hint: The nearest row (the middle of a Ring or Spiral) is the spectrum now, the lows on the left or, mirrored, in the middle; older rows roll away, so the music leaves a landscape behind it. Each beat sends a ripple out across it. Plane hides the lines behind its ridges when Solid is on.

params.label: Shape
params.help: Plane: a landscape seen from above its near edge. Ring: rows as rings round the middle, seen from above. Spiral: the ring, each row turned a little further round, so it swirls like a thumbprint.

params.label: Speed
params.help: How many rows are born a second, a little faster with the energy.

params.label: Direction
params.help: Away: the newest row is nearest (the middle of a Ring or Spiral) and the history rolls away. Toward: rows are born far off and come to you.

params.label: Mirror the spectrum
params.help: The lows in the middle, the highs out to both sides.

params.label: Width
params.help: Plane: how wide the landscape is. Spiral: how far it winds.

params.label: Terrain
params.help: Rolling hills under the spectrum, so the mesh moves even in quiet passages.

params.label: View angle
params.help: From low over it to looking straight down.

params.label: Turn
params.help: Ring and Spiral: how fast the view goes round. Plane: how far it sways.

params.label: Beat ripples
params.help: Each beat drops a ripple in the middle that runs out across the mesh.

params.label: Bass swell
params.help: How much the bass lifts the whole mesh.

params.label: Range
params.help: How far below the loudest slice the mesh reaches: more shows more of the quiet. The loudest is followed over a few seconds, so any track fills it.

params.label: Highs lift
params.help: Lifts the highs (up to 4.5 dB an octave), which are quieter in most music.

params.label: Fall
params.help: How fast the newest row falls, in full heights a second.

params.label: Wires
params.help: Grid: lines both ways. Rows: only the rows, each a spectrum line. Dots: a dot where the lines cross.

params.label: Solid
params.help: Plane: the mesh hides what is behind its ridges. Ring and Spiral are always see-through.

params.label: Reflection
params.help: The mesh mirrored faintly below itself.
